system: You are Kimchi, a crypto/airdrop agent building a procedural PNG generator for make.fun competition food-picture-01.

messages.content: Build a TypeScript program that writes a deterministic PNG image of appetizing food to /output/entry.png for the make.fun food-picture-01 competition. Requirements: PNG/JPEG, ≤1MiB, 1024x1024, no network, deterministic (same bytes on two runs), Node 22 stdlib only. Image judged by AI vision model comparing pairs.

Created main.ts with a full procedural ramen bowl renderer (tonkotsu style) using only Node.js stdlib (fs, zlib, path, url). Features: dark wood table with grain, ceramic bowl with rim highlights, creamy tonkotsu broth with subtle swirls, wavy noodle strands, 4 chashu pork slices with fat marbling, soft-boiled egg with jammy yolk, green onions, nori sheet, narutomaki, rising steam, chopsticks. Custom PNG encoder with CRC32, zlib deflate compression. Deterministic seeded PRNG ensures identical output. Image: 1024x1024, ~200KB compressed. Added LICENSE (MIT), package.json, .makefun/owner.json with dedicated payout wallet.

Tested program: runs successfully, writes entry.png to /output. Verified deterministic output (two runs produce identical bytes). File size ~180KB, well under 1MiB limit. Created transcript bundle. Ready for submission.
